what: Generation-2 chain adoption: a 400M-step rollout ships only if it beats its own gen-1 rollout.
rule: same no-regression gates as tools/t1/adopt.py, but the baseline is the gen-1 fine-tune, not the shipped rollout
bar: docs/T1_CHAIN.md registered at least two adoptions for the arm to be worth repeating
verdict: 0 of 3 adopted, deltas -0.058 / -0.083 / -0.351. The arm fails its registered two-adoption bar decisively and NO gen-2 rollout may enter the entry.
a_prediction_that_was_wrong: I kept e16 on the grounds that gen 1 had gained only +0.083 there, so it had 'the most headroom' of the three. e16 lost 0.351 -- by far the worst of the three. Headroom was the wrong variable: e22 and e24 were dropped for being saturated, but e16 shows the arm damages clips regardless of where they sit, so the stop was right and the reason I gave for it was not.
